name: LeoVince Factory S Exhaust System for BMW S1000RR
source_title: LeoVince Factory S Exhaust System for BMW S1000RR
description: LeoVince has taken all of their R&D and knowledge gained from their Factory and SBK line of exhaust and combined it to create the Leo… • Full stainless steel headers and mid-pipes. • Developed for each engine model with the aim to improve torque, power and throttle response. • Substantial weight savings over the stock exhaust. • Deep exhaust tone.
source_description_html:
LeoVince has taken all of their R&D and knowledge gained from their Factory and SBK line of exhaust and combined it to create the Leo Vince Factory Exhaust System. This amalgamation of Italian style and performance is for those seeking the very best that Leo Vince has to offer. It features a conical muffler design with a slash-cut carbon fiber end cap. Inside the Factory S you’ll find full stainless steel internal chambers. On the outside the aerodynamic inlet reduces drag while the dual spring anchorages ensure and seamless seal with the mid-pipe. Each exhaust system is tuned for each model and their stock fuel settings to improve torque, power and throttle response

The stainless steel sleeve incorporates high-quality AISI 304 stainless steel with an laser etched Leo Vince Logo. LeoVince exclusively uses 304 stainless steel for its thermal and high corrosion resistance and welding characteristics. The steel is then put through a sandblasting process that produces a distinctive titanium-like finish. This combined with the full stainless steel headers and mid-pipes will drop significant weight from your motorcycle further increasing your power to weight ratio.

Features:

  • Full stainless steel headers and mid-pipes
  • Developed for each engine model with the aim to improve torque, power and throttle response
  • Substantial weight savings over the stock exhaust
  • Deep exhaust tone
  • Carbon fiber clamp equipped with a rubber vibration damping element
  • Stainless steel muffler bands and rivets
  • Steel muffler springs
  • TIG welding throughout

The Leo Vince LV One EVO Slip-On Exhaust is the ideal combination of Italian styling with modern performance. The inlet cap and internal chambers are manufactured from AISI 304 stainless steel, which means it’s not only lightweight but also tough and impact-resistant. The exhaust's oval shape with clear and unique lines gives the silencer a unique compact profile.

The stainless steel option features a sandblasted finish giving it an elegant and gritty titanium-like look. Both versions of the LV ONE EVO are built to stand the test of time with the stainless bands and rivets and quality TIG welding. The muffler end cap is made entirely of heat-resistant carbon fiber, which gives the exhaust a decisive styling and greater resistant to high temperatures. The muffler clamp is also made entirely of carbon fiber and allows for a flawless installation.

LeoVince has taken all of their R&D and knowledge gained from their Factory and SBK line of exhaust and combined it to create the Leo Vince Factory S Slip-On Exhaust. This amalgamation of Italian style and performance is for those seeking the very best that Leo Vince has to offer. It features a conical muffler design with a slash-cut carbon fiber end cap. Inside the Factory S you’ll find full stainless steel internal chambers. On the outside the aerodynamic inlet reduces drag while the dual spring anchorages ensure and seamless seal with the mid-pipe. Each slip-on and its mid-pipe is tuned for each model and their stock fuel settings to improve torque, power and throttle response

The stainless steel option incorporates high-quality AISI 304 stainless steel with an laser etched Leo Vince Logo. LeoVince exclusively uses 304 stainless steel for its thermal and high corrosion resistance and welding characteristics. The steel is then put through a sandblasting process that produces a distinctive titanium-like finish. Combined with the carbon fiber end-cap makes this a sharp and stealthy performance package. Both options will drop significant weight from your motorcyle further increasing your power to weight ratio.

Features:

  • Developed for each engine model with the aim to improve torque, power and throttle response
  • Substantial weight savings over the stock exhaust
  • Deep exhaust tone
  • Carbon fiber clamp equipped with a rubber vibration damping element
  • Stainless steel muffler bands and rivets
  • Steel muffler springs
  • TIG welding throughout

description: Italian spirit and fighting soul. LeoVince has taken all of their R&D and knowledge gained from their Factory and SBK line of exhaust and combined… • Developed for each engine model with the aim to improve torque, power and throttle response. • Substantial weight savings over the stock exhaust. • Deep exhaust tone. • Carbon fiber clamp equipped with a rubber vibration damping element.
source_description_html:
Italian spirit and fighting soul. LeoVince has taken all of their R&D and knowledge gained from their Factory and SBK line of exhaust and combined it to create the Leo Vince Factory S Slip-On Exhaust. This amalgamation of Italian style and performance is for those seeking the very best that Leo Vince has to offer. It features a conical muffler design with a slash-cut carbon fiber end cap. Inside the Factory S you’ll find full stainless steel internal chambers. On the outside the aerodynamic inlet reduces drag while the dual spring anchorages ensure a seamless seal with the mid-pipe. Each slip-on and its mid-pipe is tuned for each model and their stock fuel settings to improve torque, power and throttle response

Two options are available for most models: stainless steel and carbon fiber. The stainless steel option incorporates high-quality AISI 304 stainless steel with an laser etched Leo Vince Logo. LeoVince exclusively uses 304 stainless steel for its thermal and high corrosion resistance and welding characteristics. The steel is then put through a sandblasting process that produces a distinctive titanium-like finish. The carbon fiber option features a flat finish with a contrasting aluminum die-cut Leo Vince logo. Combined with the carbon fiber end-cap makes this a sharp and stealthy performance package. Both options will drop significant weight from your motorcycle, further increasing your power to weight ratio.

Features:

  • Developed for each engine model with the aim to improve torque, power and throttle response
  • Substantial weight savings over the stock exhaust
  • Deep exhaust tone
  • Carbon fiber clamp equipped with a rubber vibration damping element
  • Stainless steel muffler bands and rivets
  • Steel muffler springs
  • TIG welding throughout
